how_to_apply: Visit the official JKSSB website, www.jkssb.nic.in, and go through the Advertisement Notification and instructions carefully.
Fill the online application form; applications through any other mode will not be accepted.
Clearly indicate the item number(s)/post(s) being applied for; only one application per item number is allowed.
Upload a live photograph, signature (10 KB–20 KB), category certificate (max 100 KB PDF), and qualification/experience certificates (self-attested, max 100 KB PDF) as required for the post.
Pay the applicable application fee online through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.
Review all entries carefully before final submission, since no changes are entertained after submission.
Take a printout of the submitted application form and preserve it for Document Verification; do not submit the hard copy to the JKSSB office in person, by post, or by email.

In-service candidates must additionally forward a signed and stamped printout of the application, along with the certificate at the end of the form, through their Head of Department to the Secretary, JKSSB, by the last date of Document Verification.
important_instructions: Name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name must be entered exactly as in the Matriculation Certificate, or candidature may be cancelled at the time of Document Verification. Requests for change or correction in the application form, once submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances. Only one application is allowed per item number; multiple applications for the same item will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment. Requests for modification of cadre/department preferences, once filled, will not be entertained. Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected summarily. Candidates must carry two recent passport-size photographs and an original photo ID to the examination venue, failing which they will not be allowed to appear. Use of mobile phones, smartwatches, smart glasses, AI-enabled devices, or any communication-capable device is strictly prohibited in the examination hall. Candidates found using fake/fabricated applications or misusing any dignitary's name/photo are liable for legal action under the Cyber/IT Act. The decision of the Board on eligibility, selection, examination conduct, and merit list preparation is final and binding; no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained. Grievances regarding excess fee payment can be raised through the official grievance e-mail of JKSSB only; chargeback requests are not entertained.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: JKSSB has notified a total of 518 vacancies across four departments. The Commission has clarified that the actual number of posts may increase or decrease before completion of the selection process, and JKSSB is not legally liable for such variation. The category-wise vacancy break-up (Open Merit, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes-1, Scheduled Tribes-2, Other Backward Classes, Residents of areas adjoining Line of Actual Control/International Border, Residents of Backward Areas, and Economically Weaker Sections) is given in parentheses in the table below. Candidates applying for Senior Canning Attendant require Matric or equivalent with 6 months' training in Fruit Preservation. Candidates applying for Horticulture Technician Grade-IV require 10+2 with one year Basic Horticulture training, and the training certificate must be from a Central/State/UT Government institution, a UGC-recognised university, an agricultural/horticultural university, an ICAR institute, or another institution specifically recognised by a competent authority. Qualification for Health and Medical Education Department posts varies by post: Health Educator requires Graduation with Science; Sanitary Inspector requires 10+2 or above with a minimum 2-year Diploma in Sanitation and Public Health; Junior Pharmacist requires 10+2 Science with a Degree/Diploma in Pharmacy; Para Medical Assistant requires 10+2 with a Diploma in Para Medical Assistant Course; Junior Theatre Technician requires Matric or above with a Degree/Diploma in Operational Theatre Technology; Junior Ophthalmic Technician requires Matric or above with a Degree/Diploma in Ophthalmic Technician Course; Junior Lab Technician requires Matric or above with a minimum 2-year Diploma (or degree) in Lab Technology; Junior Staff Nurse requires Matric with Science and a Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery; and FMPHW/MMPHW require Matric or above with Science and the respective Diploma (minimum 1 year for MMPHW). Candidates require a Graduate degree with Science; preference will be given to candidates holding a Post Graduate Diploma in a professional laboratory course in Chemistry or another Science subject. Graduate in Science means a Bachelor's degree in Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Zoology/Botany), or Mathematics and their derivative subjects. Candidates require Matriculation or an equivalent examination from a recognised University or Board of Examination.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and must possess a valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed format on or before the cut-off date, i.e., 9 October 2026 (unless extended). Age is calculated as on 1 January 2026. The maximum age limit varies by category, as shown below. Every Ex-Servicemen who has served in the Armed Forces is allowed to deduct the period of such service from their actual age; if the resultant age does not exceed the prescribed maximum age limit for the post by more than 3 years, they are deemed to satisfy the age condition, provided the candidate is not born after 1 January 2008. Qualification is specific to each post and district, as listed in the vacancy tables above (Annexure-A of the notification). Candidates declared qualified/shortlisted for Document Verification must produce original certificates as proof of having acquired the prescribed qualification strictly on or before the cut-off date. Any candidate holding a qualification other than as prescribed is not eligible, and such candidature will be summarily rejected at any stage. Candidates claiming an equivalent qualification must produce an Equivalence Certificate when required by the Board. Qualification varies by post, ranging from Matriculation (Supervisor, Senior Canning Attendant) to 10+2 with a diploma (Horticulture Technician, Junior Pharmacist, Junior Staff Nurse, and other paramedical posts) to a Graduate degree with Science (Health Educator, Junior Laboratory Assistant). Full post-wise qualification is listed in the vacancy tables.

content_sections.heading: Application of Reservation
content_sections.text: Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) applies to the extent communicated by the indenting departments or as per extant rules. Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen applies to posts carrying pay up to Level-6E (35900-113500). An Ex-Servicemen who has already availed Horizontal Reservation on joining a post cannot avail this benefit again for subsequent employment, and must submit a sworn affidavit and a Certificate in Form-XIV at the time of document scrutiny.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee can be paid only through online mode (Net Banking, Credit or Debit cards). Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, with no representation entertained. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstances and cannot be adjusted against any other examination.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Pay scale is specific to each post, ranging from Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200) for posts like Horticulture Technician Grade-IV, FMPHW, MMPHW, Junior Laboratory Assistant, and Supervisor, up to Level-6D (Rs. 35,800–113,200) for Sanitary Inspector and Level-6 (Rs. 35,400–112,400) for Health Educator. Junior Pharmacist, Para Medical Assistant, Junior Theatre Technician, Junior Ophthalmic Technician, Junior Lab Technician, and Junior Staff Nurse carry Level-4 (Rs. 25,500–81,100). Senior Canning Attendant carries Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200). Refer to the vacancy tables above for the exact pay level of each specific post.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Admission to the examination is provisional; the Board does not undertake detailed scrutiny of applications for eligibility at the time of the written examination. Ineligible candidates, once identified, will not be allowed to participate in subsequent stages, and issuance of an Admit Card does not confer any right to participation in later stages of selection.

content_sections.heading: Facility for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)
content_sections.text: Candidates with Benchmark Disabilities who are otherwise eligible and hold a valid disability certificate may avail the facility of a Scribe and/or compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination, on producing a Certificate from a competent Medical Board/Authority (Annexure-B) and an Undertaking (Annexure-C). The scribe must be arranged by the candidate, must not be a candidate for the same examination, must not be from the same institution or a relative of the candidate, and must hold a lower qualification than the candidate. Candidates must have applied as a PwBD candidate at the time of application and must submit the required documents to the Observer on the day of the examination.

content_sections.heading: Document Verification (DV)
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted for Document Verification must appear with original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including Birth Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Category Certificate, and qualification certificates, all of which must be legally valid on or before the cut-off date. Failure to appear for DV or to produce the required original documents on the scheduled date will result in the candidate not being considered for selection. No TA/DA is paid for participation in the written test or document verification.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Domicile Certificate of Jammu & Kashmir, issued by the competent authority, valid up to the cut-off date Educational qualification certificates as prescribed for the specific post Birth Certificate/Matriculation Certificate (for date of birth) Category Certificate (SC/ST-1/ST-2/OBC/EWS/ALC-IB/RBA), in the prescribed format, valid as on the cut-off date Certificate in Form-XIV for Ex-Servicemen candidates, as per Rule 18 of Jammu and Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005 Person with Disability Certificate (self-attested) for PwBD candidates, along with Annexure-B and Annexure-C if availing Scribe/compensatory time Bonafide Certificate (Board-prescribed format) for candidates with a degree from a University/Institute outside J&K (other than Central Universities) Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months, with date mentioned) Original valid photo ID proof: Aadhaar Card/e-Aadhaar printout, Voter ID Card, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport, School/College/University ID Card, or Employer ID Card
